notes: Reviewed Panel L-I (Doc 34) and extended template schema for Light templates L1-L5. Added Level enum values for non-cortical and endocrine pathway representation (subcortical, neuroendocrine), added template/link fields for parallel-channel convergence (causal_topology, convergence_rule, channel_id, converges_on), and added temporal metadata for rate-of-change and circadian timescales (temporal.scale, temporal.variable_type).
changes_to_plan: CC template encoders can now represent L2 ipRGC->SCN->pineal pathway levels without overloading generic neural/physiological labels.
L3 multi-channel daylight convergence can be encoded explicitly as parallel/hybrid topology with channel metadata.
L5 dynamic-light mechanisms can encode rate-of-change and 24-hour temporal context directly on causal links.
